# Path mechanics (generated by tools/romania_focus_gen/paths.py).

# ---- Simion: Movement Legitimacy 0-100. Each point above or below 50 is worth 0.2% stability and 0.4% political power.
ROM_update_legitimacy = {
	clamp_variable = { var = ROM_legitimacy min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { ROM_leg_stab = ROM_legitimacy }
	subtract_from_variable = { ROM_leg_stab = 50 }
	set_variable = { ROM_leg_pp = ROM_leg_stab }
	divide_variable = { ROM_leg_stab = 500 }
	divide_variable = { ROM_leg_pp = 250 }
}

# ---- Simion: three factions, 0-100 each. The strongest one holds a ROM_sim_dominant_* flag.
ROM_update_factions = {
	clamp_variable = { var = ROM_faction_moderates min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ROM_faction_radicals min = 0 max = 100 }
	clamp_variable = { var = ROM_faction_machine min = 0 max = 100 }
	clr_country_flag = ROM_sim_dominant_moderates
	clr_country_flag = ROM_sim_dominant_radicals
	clr_country_flag = ROM_sim_dominant_machine
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = ROM_faction_moderates value = ROM_faction_radicals compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = ROM_faction_moderates value = ROM_faction_machine compare = greater_than_or_equals }
		}
		set_country_flag = ROM_sim_dominant_moderates
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { var = ROM_faction_radicals value = ROM_faction_machine compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
		set_country_flag = ROM_sim_dominant_radicals
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = ROM_sim_dominant_machine
	}
}

# ---- Antonescu: Public Consent 0-100. Each point above or below 50 is worth 0.25% stability and 0.2% war support.
ROM_update_consent = {
	clamp_variable = { var = ROM_consent min = 0 max = 100 }
	set_variable = { ROM_consent_stab = ROM_consent }
	subtract_from_variable = { ROM_consent_stab = 50 }
	set_variable = { ROM_consent_ws = ROM_consent_stab }
	divide_variable = { ROM_consent_stab = 400 }
	divide_variable = { ROM_consent_ws = 500 }
}

# ---- Antonescu: Defence Effort 1-5. Each level above 1: +5% military factory output speed,
# +1.5% consumer goods, +1% recruitable population.
ROM_update_defence_effort = {
	clamp_variable = { var = ROM_defence_effort min = 1 max = 5 }
	set_variable = { ROM_def_arms = ROM_defence_effort }
	subtract_from_variable = { ROM_def_arms = 1 }
	set_variable = { ROM_def_cg = ROM_def_arms }
	set_variable = { ROM_def_consc = ROM_def_arms }
	multiply_variable = { ROM_def_arms = 0.05 }
	multiply_variable = { ROM_def_cg = 0.015 }
	multiply_variable = { ROM_def_consc = 0.01 }
}

# Called once a month from ROM_corruption_monthly.
ROM_paths_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ROM_consent }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = ROM_defence_effort }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROM_defence_effort > 3 } }
				add_to_variable = { ROM_consent = -1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROM_defence_effort > 2 } }
				add_to_variable = { ROM_consent = -0.5 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { ROM_defence_effort < 2 } }
				add_to_variable = { ROM_consent = 0.5 }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = ROM_permanent_emergency_idea }
			add_to_variable = { ROM_consent = -0.5 }
		}
		ROM_update_consent = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROM_consent < 30 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_consent_crisis_cooldown }
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = ROM_consent_crisis_cooldown days = 180 value = 1 }
			country_event = { id = ROM_ant.3}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ROM_legitimacy }
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = ROM_eu_funds_frozen_idea }
			add_to_variable = { ROM_legitimacy = -0.5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_idea = ROM_sovereignty_mandate_idea }
			add_to_variable = { ROM_legitimacy = 0.25 }
		}
		ROM_update_legitimacy = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROM_legitimacy < 25 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_legitimacy_crisis_cooldown }
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = ROM_legitimacy_crisis_cooldown days = 180 value = 1 }
			country_event = { id = ROM_sim.4}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = ROM_dracula_path }
		ROM_dracula_monthly = yes
	}
}
